title: Configuration and options in one screen
rememberThis: Provider chain: appsettings.json → appsettings.{Environment}.json → user secrets → env vars → command line. Last wins.
Environment variables use double underscore: ConnectionStrings__OrdersDb maps to ConnectionStrings:OrdersDb.
IOptions = static singleton. IOptionsSnapshot = per request. IOptionsMonitor = hot reload + OnChange for feature flags.
ValidateOnStart catches bad config at deploy — before K8s readiness passes.
Secrets: user secrets (dev), K8s env vars (containers), Key Vault + managed identity (Azure prod). Never in git.
bullets: WebApplication.CreateBuilder registers the default provider chain automatically.
services.Configure<T>(section) binds configuration to a POCO for DI injection.
IOptionsSnapshot cannot be injected into singleton services — use IOptionsMonitor instead.
Key Vault secret names use -- (Jwt--SigningKey); env vars use __ (Jwt__SigningKey).
reloadOnChange: true on JSON enables file watcher; IOptionsMonitor reacts to IChangeToken.
Connection string changes usually require pod restart — connection pools cache the old server.
